description: Spring flood mapping is a series of datasets listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Données linked to the monitoring of the 2020 floods in Quebec Liste of available data: Location of flood events since April 2, 2020 (WMS web service); Municipalities affected by flood events since April 2, 2020, updated in real time according to the presence of events (WMS web service); Limits of the extent of open waters ... Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Carte, Catastrophe, Crue, Spring flood, Flood. It offers 10 resource(s) in GEOTIF, HTML, SHP, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
